summary: Execution of decree; extension of time by executing court; doctrine of merger; decree of appellate court supersedes trial court; Section 148 CPC, no time limit; executing court jurisdiction to extend time; Section 53A Transfer of Property Act inapplicable due to pendency of suit and prior lease; lis pendens; challenge to extension as decree modification rejected; delay not fatal; personal law and French nationality noted but not determinative; High Court's dismissal of revision upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 O.47 R.1
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; impugned judgment of High Court upheld; no interference with execution of decree or extension of time.
